note: Exact defects for the current canonical PostgreSQL fixture. The oversell mutant removes the row lock that supplies concurrency safety. The checkout mutant deterministically preserves consumed cart lines, proving the idempotency oracle without depending on request scheduling. Promotion requires only the declared criteria to fail conclusively.

mutations.desc: Drop FOR UPDATE from the positive-stock row selection. Concurrent buyers can select the same last unit before their updates serialize, allowing the row to be decremented below zero.
Keep checked-out cart lines instead of deleting them, so the second checkout deterministically sees the same cart and creates a duplicate order.
